issues.detail: Manual final sentence now requests picture-element rows only; corrected and hashed before packet creation.

Independent outcome-blind registrar must supply line AND block boxes, exact EVT crosswalk, H/F count discrepancies and dropped blocks. Existing tool accepts annotations but does not produce an automatic crosswalk.

Specify exact between-label weights, cluster variance, covariance handling, undefined-permutation policy and seeds before scoring. v3 uses inverse folio-cluster variance; v4 does not explicitly select that formula.
Third rater returns picture boxes on whole disagreement pages; retain third-rater labels for disputed lines only. Separate final six-way and binary-majority labels are required.

Strata include length bin but not position. Within-folio label permutations do not preserve label-position association. The wrap/position null must qualify this; a pass cannot by itself establish adjustment for every position variable.

Specify label-support and multi-label-folio selection order, total-V denominator, and whether qualifying support is recomputed under each shuffle before scoring. Support uses prefix counts, not qok outcomes.
Freeze baselines, position functions, folio effects, dependence assumptions, rejection alpha and seeds for all six scenarios. 200 trials are binding; do not tune after seeing failures.
Agent reported automatically injected project memory and stopped before reading either permitted file. No picture raters were dispatched. See BLINDNESS-AUDIT.json.
